sentences.text:
This application coming on for admission this day, the court passed the following:
 ORDER

This is first application filed by applicant under Section 438 of Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of anticipatory bail relating to FIR No.409/2023, registered at Police Station-Itarsi Nagar,
District-Narmadapuram (MP) for the offence punishable under Sections 420, 506 of the IPC.
2. Learned counsel appearing for the applicant submitted that applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the case.
It is submitted that there is no criminal dispute between applicant and complainant.
In fact, there was civil transaction between the parties.
Later on, due to some financial difficulty money could not be returned, therefore, false complaint under Sections 420, 506 of the IPC has been registered against the applicant.
It is submitted that a notice for recovery of money was given to him on 11.02.2021.

Said notice clearly reflects that some loan amount has been taken by applicant which has not been returned, therefore, notice was given for recovery of said money but Shrikant Mantri vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/164938112/

sentences.text: 1 after some period of time, complainant has lodged a police report to settle civil score by resorting to criminal proceeding.
In these circumstances, applicant may be enlarged on anticipatory bail.
3 . Learned Government Advocate appearing for the State has opposed the anticipatory bail application.

It is submitted that as per prosecution story, applicant misrepresented to complainant that his money will be doubled within 2-3 years and on his assurance complainant who has taken loan from Bank has given him the amount.
Later on, money was not returned.
It is submitted that money was delivered to applicant on basis of his misrepresentation, therefore, offence of cheating is made out against the applicant.

4. Heard learned counsel for the parties and also perused notice dated 11.02.2021.
5.
From perusal of notice dated 11.02.2021, it is clear that there was civil loan transaction between applicant and complainant and amount has not been returned.
6 . Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, without commenting on merits of the case, anticipatory bail application filed by the applicant is allowed.

7 . It is directed that applicant be released on anticipatory bail on his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Arresting officer (Investigating Officer) for his regular appearance before the Police during the investigation or before the Court during trial as and when directed.
8. The applicant is directed to join the investigation immediately and co- operate with the investigating agency.

He will further abide by the condition enumerated in sub-section (2) of Section 438 of the Cr.P.C.
9.
